name: badge
useFor: Use Badge for a short status or category beside a name (New, Team, Passed, PR #482). Use default for most tags, solid for a plan or a state that should stand out, accent once per view for the thing that matters (Most popular), success, warning and destructive for check states. asChild turns a link into a tag.
constraints: Lowercase or sentence-case labels (the label is set in capitals by the font style)
Two accent tags in one view
source: The Hoplite website's .tag (pricing, the hero's pill) and the nav's news card (.hn__news, New)
title: Badge
description: The site's tag: a 20px hexagon with 8px cuts and a 12px Kode Mono capital label. Default is the outlined tag (strong edge, ink label); solid is ink, accent the orange edge and label, plus status, outline, secondary, destructive and ghost.
